profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer and Web Developer with the ability and willingness to work on a wide range of products using many different technologies. I am always striving to perform the best job possible on any project I am involved in and use every opportunity as a learning experience.  So best practices, patterns, and constantly reading and exploring are part of my professional and personal goals as a developer.  I also feel I can get in touch with my creative side, I am not a graphic artist but I do plan to make strides and develop my artistic skills in my spare time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed as a core engineer on a greenfield logistics and device‑tracking platform, delivering full‑stack features across ASP.NET Core services, Angular applications, and Azure‑hosted infrastructure.

• Helped establish the initial AI foundations of the product by transforming early prototypes into stable, maintainable .NET components. Worked from high‑level concepts to create reliable AI workflows that support natural language queries, data summarization, and automated insight generation.

• Strengthened the platform’s AI capabilities by introducing clearer patterns for request handling, validation, streaming, and error recovery—resulting in a more predictable and user‑friendly AI experience.

• Improved the application’s data‑driven insights by implementing a flexible chart‑generation workflow using ECharts configuration objects, enabling consistent styling, faster rendering performance, and interactive chart features.

• Standardized client‑side architecture by introducing NgRx and later NgRx Signals Store to provide a predictable, maintainable approach to state management for the Angular application.

• Modernized CI/CD practices by designing streamlined Azure DevOps pipelines that support Dev, Demo, Staging, and Production environments. Added gated approvals, secure variable management, and environment‑specific deployment workflows.

• Created Bicep‑based Infrastructure‑as‑Code templates for key Azure resources to support fast, consistent provisioning of cloud environments for new stages of development and testing.

• Strengthened backend reliability and maintainability by improving telemetry, refining exception handling practices, and improving overall application flexibility by utilizing configuration and feature flags.

• Participated in code reviews, contributed to architectural discussions, and identified technical improvements across the backend, AI services, and deployment infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Azure · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · TypeScript · Angular · NgRx · Azure SQL · ASP.NET Core · Application Insights · .NET Core · Azure DevOps · Azure Functions · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · Python (Programming Language) · Visual Studio · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Jupyter · Git · PostgreSQL · Application Configuration · Microsoft Agent Framework · Redis · Jest · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Neo4j · Playwright testing · Powershell · Anthropic Claude · OpenAI API

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Strengthened the Microsoft Personnel platform by driving modernization efforts in the Screening domain, introducing configuration-driven architecture, removing brittle hard-coded logic, expanding automated test coverage, and improving long-term maintainability of critical features.

• Partnered with the development lead on feature planning and architectural design, influencing product direction and helping shape scalable, future-proof implementations.

• Delivered high-impact full-stack solutions using C#, .NET, and React.js, integrating improved telemetry and observability patterns to enhance system diagnostics and reliability.

• Authored detailed technical documentation for previously undocumented workflows, improving onboarding efficiency and reducing institutional knowledge gaps.

• Contributed to Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) and developed proofs of concept for large result-set filtering solutions, improving backend performance and UI responsiveness.

• Collaborated across multiple engineering domains to deliver cross-cutting features in shared codebases, improving consistency and engineering velocity across the Personnel ecosystem.

• Served as interim development lead for three months, coordinating the delivery of a new document storage subsystem, facilitating design discussions, and unblocking engineers.

• Mentored a software engineering intern. Provided technical guidance, onboarding support, and weekly collaboration.

• Partnered with a cross-domain team to migrate a complex ETL pipeline from Python to Azure Synapse, improving scalability and enabling integration with modern Personnel application features.

• Took part in Microsoft Hackathon as part of the BAM Employee Resource Group to help create a mobile application. Contributions focused on developing the mobile application using .NET MAUI to consume REST APIs. Developed UI/UX views based on mockups to demonstrate initial functionality and concepts of the application.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET Core · .NET Core · React.js · Microsoft Azure · Azure Cosmos DB · Azure Synapse Analytics · Azure DevOps · Git · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Application Insights · Visual Studio · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · .NET MAUI · App Center · xUnit · CSS · Jupyter

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
• Created the base infrastructure for the application foundation of a new logistics web application that combined the functionality of three legacy systems.  Established Agile project structure for front end development team – including Scrum ceremonies, development sprints, Jira issue tracking, peer code reviews and developer quality assurance (unit testing and minimum code coverage required) 

• Created a prototype, Smart City web app that utilized multiple Azure technologies (App Service Web app, Azure Function, Cosmos DB, Azure AD B2C), JavaScript mapping library, and Angular to query various data collections about the city of Atlanta 

• Created a cash-sharing mobile app in Xamarin.Forms for Android and iOS platforms that utilized an ASP.NET Web API to communicate with resources in AWS - including Cognito - for user management 

• Created Android and UWP print shop mobile apps using Xamarin.Forms that provided role-based functionality for managing print items – replacing the existing paper-based workflow 

• Developed the initial Open Data Repository web app for Microsoft.  Worked on a two-person team to connect custom backend services and Azure services into the UI 

• Participate in the entire project lifecycle – including providing technical support on potential customer sales calls, creating the architectural design, implementing the solution and supporting the project post-deployment

• Assisted in graphic design tasks using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Completed an internship and further worked as a freelance web designer.
Developed and maintained websites utilizing PHP, MySQL, XHTML, JavaScript, and CSS.
Provided designs for websites and graphical content as well as photo editing.
Involved in every aspect of project from project management, web development, and publishing.
Completed research projects on utilizing new technologies and competitive web analysis.

positions.title: Data Entry
positions.description:
Completed data and image entry into layouts to be used for electronic copies of different pumps manuals using a combination of Photoshop and QuarkXpress.
Worked independently on tasks involving image editing, proofing, and ensuring that content was easily readable and fully updated with new information.  
Assisted with updating pump information on the company's website using their CMS system.  
Work on the website required image editing as well as content revising. complete
